threadDescriptions.vacuum-replacement: Secure a warranty replacement for the failed vacuum
threadDescriptions.appliance-ledger: Maintain the household appliance warranty inventory
threadDescriptions.blender-extension: Decide whether to purchase the blender's optional coverage extension
threadDescriptions.courier-collection: Arrange courier collection of the faulty vacuum
threadDescriptions.coat-alteration: Have the sleeves of my winter coat shortened
threadDescriptions.freezer-proof: Recover the missing freezer proof of purchase

items.text: Vacuum service email offers a replacement motor unit under warranty. Reply with a photo of the cracked mounting tab before they release it.
items.rationale: Evidence requirement for warranty replacement.

items.text: Household appliance ledger columns: purchase date, warranty end, serial, receipt location. Add a retired flag so replaced appliances remain traceable.
items.rationale: Defines the household warranty inventory structure.

items.text: Winter coat fitting: shorten sleeves by 3 cm, keep the cuff buttons. Tailor wants me to wear the thick jumper at the second fitting.
items.rationale: Personal clothing alteration.

items.text: Blender extension offer: two extra years for 38. Read whether the jug and seal are excluded before deciding.
items.rationale: Reviews optional coverage terms and price.

items.text: Freezer receipt missing from the kitchen folder. The retailer can retrieve it using the delivery postcode and approximate month; ask for a duplicate invoice.
items.rationale: Recovery of purchase evidence for the freezer.

items.text: Faulty vacuum return label says pickup Friday, one carton, maximum 8 kg. Leave the battery out because the collection instruction covers only the motor unit.
items.rationale: Courier packing and collection instructions.

items.text: It's the older serial, not the one on the box.
items.rationale: No named appliance or record identifies the intended task.

items.text: Warranty inventory first pass: blender cover ends in April, freezer in November. The vacuum row stays open until a replacement serial is issued.
items.rationale: Updates inventory entries; other appliances are referenced as records.

items.text: Vacuum tab close-up accepted. Supplier now confirms they will send an entire replacement body, not just the motor unit described in the first email.
items.rationale: Explicit revision of the replacement's scope.

items.text: Blender extension excludes the jug, seals and wear parts. Those are what I was worried about, so decline the offer and keep the existing cover.
items.rationale: Decision on optional coverage based on its terms.

items.text: Duplicate freezer invoice arrived, but delivery month is wrong by one. Ask the retailer to check the order record before treating it as our proof of purchase.
items.rationale: Validates recovered documentation and identifies an error.

items.text: Vacuum replacement approved; supplier needs the faulty body returned first. Confirm Friday's collection, pack the body without its battery, and upload the courier acceptance receipt to release the replacement shipment.
items.rationale: Links approval/release conditions with concrete return logistics.

items.text: Keep the receipt until it clears.
items.rationale: Several tasks use receipts and no referent is provided.

items.text: Coat sleeves pinned at the second fitting. Left cuff needed half a centimetre less taken off; tailor marked the two sides individually.
items.rationale: Fitting adjustment for the coat.

items.text: Courier collected the boxed vacuum at 11:15. Tracking scan confirms one parcel; save the pickup receipt from the driver's terminal.
items.rationale: Confirms collection and shipment evidence.

items.text: Supplier has the vacuum return scan and released the replacement body. The warranty end stays the original date rather than restarting.
items.rationale: Replacement fulfillment and coverage outcome.

items.text: Retailer corrected the freezer invoice against the delivery record. Saved the PDF under Kitchen/Freezer; the purchase date now matches the delivery note.
items.rationale: Resolves and stores the recovered purchase proof.

items.text: Same date as before, apparently.
items.rationale: Date alone cannot identify warranty expiry, pickup or document correction.

items.text: Warranty ledger review finished. Entered the new vacuum serial, marked its old row retired, and linked the corrected freezer invoice. Blender extension column says declined. The replacement vacuum keeps the original coverage end date, so I copied that date across rather than using the delivery day. Leave both vacuum rows visible when filtering the inventory; otherwise a future search for the old serial will look as though it never existed. I added a document-type column because an order acknowledgement and a paid invoice were both previously labelled receipt. Each link now opens the intended local file. The paper copies stay in the kitchen folder in appliance order, with the inventory showing which documents also have a digital copy. Review this sheet again when another appliance is bought or replaced.
items.rationale: Consolidates outcomes into the inventory; no new claim or purchasing action.

items.text: Collected the winter coat. Both cuffs clear my hands with the jumper on; keep the tailor's alteration ticket in case a seam loosens.
items.rationale: Acceptance of the completed clothing work.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: this is a ledger update recording an already-made decision, not work evaluating or purchasing the extension.
